editorialScope: Memory-centric compute products and enabling memories.

companies.name: Yizhu Technology
companies.note: Current architecture is all-digital 3D DRAM CIM; earlier materials described RRAM.

companies.name: MemSilicon
companies.origin: Incubated from the Institute of Microelectronics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (Liu Ming group). Co-founder: Prof. Liu Qi, Fudan University.
companies.note: MountTai is an RRAM memory device; the LPU compute engine is in separate development.

companies.name: MicroNanoCore
companies.origin: Incubated by the Peking University Advanced Institute of Information Technology (Zhejiang). Founder and chief scientist Ye Le (叶乐), associate professor at the PKU School of Integrated Circuits; research in CIM AI chips, 3D integration and mixed-signal circuits. Lineage: PKU Ru Huang–Ye Le group; joint 3D-TokSIM research with Ru Huang's team.
companies.note: Earlier shipped chips are non-CIM; the 3D-CIM family is pre-shipment.

people.name: Ye Le · 叶乐
people.role: Founder & Chief Scientist; Associate Professor and PhD supervisor, PKU School of Integrated Circuits; Deputy Director, PKU Advanced Institute of Information Technology (Zhejiang).

companies.name: WITMEM
companies.origin: Founders from Peking University, UCLA and UCSB research groups. Joint CIM laboratory with Peking University established 2024.
companies.note: WTM2101 is in commercial production; WTM-8 is trial-manufactured.

companies.name: REEXEN
companies.origin: Founded by a PhD team from multiple universities.
companies.note: ADA400 platform and early ADA series are at different maturity stages.

companies.name: Houmo AI
companies.origin: Founding team of AI-chip researchers and industry engineers.

companies.name: Dongfang Suanxin
companies.origin: Academic ties to Tsinghua University reconfigurable-computing research (Prof. Shaojun Wei).
companies.note: DF1000 is 3D-stacked near-memory compute; 6.4 TB/s is internal memory bandwidth.

companies.name: PIMCHIP
companies.origin: Founding team from Duke University ECE (Yiran Chen, Yaojun Zhang) and industry IC design. ISSCC 2022 28 nm, 32 Kb ADC-less digital SRAM-CIM macro co-developed with the Peking University Ru Huang–Bonan Yan group, Duke University and NeoNexus.
companies.note: ISSCC 2022 macro: 32 Kb, 28 nm, 27.38 TOPS/W signed INT8, 1.041 Mb/mm² memory density (research macro, distinct from S300). Earlier reports also list Hsinchu and Singapore offices.

people.name: Yiran Chen · 陈怡然
people.role: Co-founder and founding chairman (2021–2022); Professor, Duke ECE; ISSCC 2022 co-author

people.name: Yue Yang · 杨越
people.role: Co-founder and CEO (2021–2026); former Micron system architect; ISSCC 2022 co-author

people.name: Yaojun Zhang · 章尧君
people.role: Co-founder and founding CTO (2021–2022); former doctoral student of Yiran Chen; ISSCC 2022 co-author

people.name: Jeng-Long Hsu · 许振隆
people.role: Founding IC-design team; former TSMC; ISSCC 2022 co-author

people.name: Bonan Yan · 燕博南
people.role: ISSCC 2022 first author; PKU research leader; Duke PhD (advisors Yiran Chen, Hai Li)

companies.name: InnoMemTech
companies.origin: Originated in the School of Integrated Circuits, Tsinghua University.
companies.note: 30M+ shipped units are standalone RRAM memory products.

companies.name: d-Matrix
companies.origin: Founded by Sid Sheth and Sudeep Bhoja.

companies.name: Axelera AI
companies.origin: Incubated by Bitfury AI with imec; team from IBM, imec and other research labs.
companies.note: Europa is a separate generation from Metis.

companies.name: EnCharge AI
companies.origin: Spin-out of Prof. Naveen Verma's group, Electrical Engineering, Princeton University.
companies.note: Charge-domain analog CIM; EN100 figures are vendor-reported.

companies.name: TetraMem
companies.origin: Co-founded by RRAM researchers Miao Hu, Joshua Yang and Qiangfei Xia.

companies.name: Mythic
companies.origin: Founded by semiconductor and analog-architecture researchers.
companies.note: M1076 is the current architecture; Vanguard is the next generation.

companies.name: UPMEM
companies.origin: Founded by processing-in-memory researchers and engineers.
companies.note: Processing in DRAM via general-purpose DPUs; no fixed-weight analog crossbar.

companies.name: SK hynix
companies.note: AiM is distinct from standard commercial GDDR6.

companies.name: Samsung Electronics
companies.note: PIM devices are distinct from standard DRAM and HBM production.

companies.name: GSI Technology
companies.note: Associative Boolean operations (POPS) are not equivalent to dense GEMM TOPS.

companies.name: NeuroBlade
companies.note: Near-data analytics query execution; not tensor MAC CIM.

companies.name: Synthara
companies.origin: Spin-off of the Institute of Neuroinformatics, University of Zurich / ETH Zurich; founded by Manu V. Nair and Alessandro Aimar.
companies.note: ComputeRAM is embedded macro IP, not a standalone accelerator.

products.name: 3D-DRAM digital CIM family / YICA
products.system: Card / workstation / inference cluster; capacity ND
products.scale: PCIe / RoCE / RDMA; YZCCL cluster software
products.software: YICA ISA, CUDA-compatible compiler, PyTorch/Triton integration
products.caveat: Core technology is 3D DRAM (2026 company site); earlier articles described RRAM. 88% TCO reduction is a vendor figure.

products.name: MountTai 2026 (泰山一号)
products.class: Enabling memory technology; hybrid CIM roadmap
products.array: 1 Gb storage array (not a MAC array)
products.software: RRAM IP; RRAM+DRAM hybrid CIM roadmap
products.confidence: High for memory specs; no CIM product proof
products.caveat: 1 Gb RRAM memory device; not a CIM MAC engine.

products.name: 3D-CIM; PCIe-CIM; LP-CIM
products.locus: SRAM matrix engine coupled to vertically stacked memory
products.software: RV-CIM ISA; compiler; function libraries; simulator
products.caveat: Earlier shipment volumes relate to non-CIM products.

products.name: WTM2101
products.locus: Analog matrix/NN computation inside flash memory
products.scale: Standalone edge SoC; no multi-chip scale-up
products.software: WTM SDK / model tools; developer resources
products.maturity: Mass production; deployed in edge devices
products.caveat: Throughput is 50 GOPS (not TOPS); the analog flash array is a subset of total MCU memory.

products.name: WTM-8
products.memory: Flash-derived proprietary 3D CIM; exact array medium ND
products.caveat: Unit for the 64M capacity figure not stated by vendor.

products.name: ADA100 / ADA200
products.locus: SRAM array mixed-signal multiply + ASP sensor preprocessing
products.precision: INT8 class; exact conversion details ND
products.caveat: Always-on sensing power differs from neural-engine peak power.

products.name: ADA300N / ADA300D / ADA400-DN-Board
products.locus: SRAM in-array MAC + vertical NAND/DRAM + attention
products.scale: Chiplets; vertical bonding; larger AI server
products.caveat: 2 TB+ is system memory, not compute SRAM; 4 TB/s is internal, not PCIe bandwidth.

products.name: H30 (鸿途)
products.software: 后摩大道 / model compiler / deployment
products.caveat: TOPS/W may be quoted at array or chip level.

products.name: M50 (漫界)
products.precision: INT8, INT16, FP16, FP32, bFP16, bFP24 supported
products.system: Up to 48 GB LPDDR5; up to 153.6 GB/s external BW
products.scale: PCIe Gen4 x4; HM-Link 16 GB/s; multi-die cards
products.software: Houmo Dadao stack; model conversion / runtime
products.confidence: High primary source for announced specs
products.caveat: 48 GB is LPDDR5 capacity, not SRAM-CIM array; power is chip-level unless stated.

products.name: Next-generation 3D CIM
products.caveat: Roadmap architecture, distinct from M50.

products.name: DF1000 / QY100 / TY64
products.system: DF1000 / TY64 products; per-chip capacity ND
products.scale: DF1000 cards, QY100 servers, TY64 64-card server
products.caveat: 6.4 TB/s is internal memory bandwidth, not external I/O.

products.name: PIMCHIP-S300
products.system: Up to 1,792 KB system SRAM; up to 32 MB PSRAM
products.power: 100 μW–5 mW is AON subsystem only
products.software: RTOS, middleware, model zoo, one-click deployment
products.caveat: Always-on subsystem power differs from 0.5-TOPS operating power.

products.name: RRAM AI chips / embedded IP
products.maturity: RRAM memory in production since 2021; CIM SoC in development
products.caveat: 30M+ shipped units are standalone RRAM memory chips.

products.name: CiNOR (Flash CIM)
products.caveat: Flash memory in production; CIM accelerator details limited.

products.name: Corsair
products.locus: Digital compute tightly integrated with SRAM
products.memory: 2 GB on-card compute SRAM + off-card LPDDR5
products.array: 2 GB of integrated Performance Memory per card (aggregate; not one macro)
products.system: Up to 256 GB LPDDR5 capacity memory / card
products.throughput: 2,400 TFLOPS MXINT8; 9,600 TFLOPS MXINT4; 150 TB/s local SRAM BW
products.coprocessor: Digital MAC, control and vector operators
products.scale: PCIe Gen5, DMX Link/Bridge; multi-card racks
products.maturity: Full production announced June 2026; volume shipment beginning
products.confidence: High primary specs; availability is vendor claim
products.caveat: 2 GB is distributed compute SRAM per card; 256 GB LPDDR5 is capacity memory. TFLOPS are peak, not measured LLM throughput.

products.name: Raptor 3D DRAM
products.caveat: Next-generation concept, distinct from the Corsair memory hierarchy.

products.name: Metis
products.locus: True in-SRAM-array MVM across 4 AI cores
products.coprocessor: 4 IMC cores + host CPU for prep/post
products.scale: PCIe Gen3 x4; multiple AIPUs per board
products.software: Voyager SDK, compiler, model zoo, ONNX / Python
products.caveat: TOPS follow the vendor MAC convention; normalize before comparing.

products.name: Europa
products.locus: More in-SRAM compute cores with RISC-V vector processors
products.memory: SRAM-CIM + up to 64 GB backing memory
products.array: 128 MB L2 SRAM; 8 IMC cores (macro breakdown ND)
products.system: Up to 64 GB module memory; 200 GB/s DRAM bandwidth
products.caveat: Next generation after Metis.

products.name: EN100 M.2 / 4-chip PCIe
products.locus: Charge-domain analog MAC on capacitor-SRAM-like arrays
products.precision: INT8 peak; other precision digital path ND
products.throughput: >200 TOPS M.2; up to ~1 POPS 4-chip PCIe
products.caveat: 200 TOPS at 8.25 W is the board envelope; 40 TOPS/W is core efficiency.

products.name: MLX200
products.precision: ONNX compiler INT8 / INT4; 8-bit multilevel cells
products.system: On-array nonvolatile weights; external memory ND
products.software: ONNX compile + quantization, C++ and RISC-V
products.maturity: Silicon validated May 2026; eval kits H2 2026
products.confidence: High primary for stage and specs
products.caveat: Production shipments on the 2026 roadmap.

products.name: M1076 AMP
products.caveat: Figures apply to the M1076 generation; Vanguard is separate.

products.name: Vanguard
products.locus: Flash analog IMC die and digital die / hybrid
products.caveat: Planned for 2027.

products.name: DRAM-PIM DDR4 DIMM
products.precision: 32-bit RISC (not native GEMM INT8 precision metric)
products.scale: Host-mediated inter-DPU; no direct DPU-to-DPU network
products.software: UPMEM C / Rust SDK, host APIs, compiler
products.caveat: 2.56 TB/s is aggregate DPU-local bandwidth, not DIMM interface bandwidth; general-purpose DPUs, no tensor TOPS rating.

products.name: GDDR6-AiM / AiMX
products.locus: Digital vector processing near DRAM banks
products.throughput: 1 TFLOPS BF16 per chip; 64 GB/s external chip BW
products.coprocessor: AiM controller, CPU/GPU host, FPGA ref platform
products.scale: AiMX accelerator board; GPU co-processing demos
products.caveat: 8 Gb is DRAM capacity; processing units sit alongside banks.

products.name: HBM2-PIM / Aquabolt-XL
products.locus: Processing units in HBM DRAM bank-periphery
products.system: HBM stack memory; exact SKU varies
products.caveat: Distinct from standard HBM product lines.

products.name: LPDDR5X-PIM (2026 demo)
products.throughput: Up to 8× effective BW; 2–3× inference throughput (demo workloads)
products.caveat: Speedups measured on vendor demo workloads.

products.name: Gemini I / Gemini II APU
products.precision: Variable bit-level Boolean operations (not directly GEMM INT8)
products.maturity: Gemini I full production limited sales; Gemini II preproduction in 2026 SEC filing
products.caveat: Boolean POPS are not comparable to MAC TOPS. APU revenue reported as immaterial in SEC filings.

products.name: SPU / DAXL
products.locus: Compute engines close to memory for SQL/analytics
products.precision: Data-analytics operators, not ML INT8 MAC
products.throughput: Database query workload metrics, not NN TOPS
products.caveat: Database and analytics acceleration; not an LLM tensor engine.

products.name: ComputeRAM IP
products.throughput: Performance application-dependent; no fixed TOPS public
products.caveat: Macro capacity in KB; not comparable with card-level DRAM.

products.name: PIMCHIP-N300
products.software: Vendor NPU development stack; details ND
products.caveat: Mixed-precision modes may share datapaths; macro bit widths not published.
